_comment: Production settings for the deployed Abhiverse API, the single source of truth the config-drift job compares against. Values with $ are CI variables, resolved at deploy time, never committed.

env._note: Demo deployment state is ephemeral by design: the coordination service holds no database yet (PostgreSQL is on the roadmap). A container revision resets pairings; judges and users pair fresh. The VPS staging bundle (deploy/) keeps persistent state.
